descricao: Level 24 is a plastic scale model of the Frontrooms solar system composed of a high-density polyethylene-polystyrene blend and lead paint. Calculations based on measurements and substantial observation made from within the level estimate that it is a 1:1 scale representation of its likeness. As of 2020/09/24, there is a total of 11 observable celestial bodies: the Sun1, the Moon, and eight of the nine known planets2.
